scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server && cp -r client/dist server/dist/public
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --legacy-peer-deps --prefix client && npm install --legacy-peer-deps --prefix server
